scripts.external:test: node --test scripts/external-hosting/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec tsx --test src/lib/external-hosting.test.ts
scripts.release:test: node --test scripts/release/verify-publish.test.mjs scripts/release/provisioning-schema-contract.test.mjs scripts/release/commercial-schema-contract.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec tsx --test src/products/exchange/readiness-limits.test.ts src/products/exchange/calculation.test.ts src/products/exchange/public-configuration.test.ts src/modules/entitlements/commercial-pricing.test.ts
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
